title: Indian Para-Badminton Stars Shine in Japan with Gold, Silver, and Milestone
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton players Pramod Bhagat and Sukant Kadam achieved significant success in Japan, with Bhagat winning gold and silver, and Kadam reaching a career milestone of 100 medals.
summary: Indian para-badminton ace Pramod Bhagat secured a gold and a silver medal at a tournament in Japan, while his compatriot Sukant Kadam celebrated a remarkable career milestone by completing his 100th medal haul. This showcases India's strong presence in international para-badminton.

title: BAI Advanced Coaches Course Commences in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course, held in two Indian cities, is crucial for developing high-level badminton coaching talent within the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has commenced its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course today, running until September 23, 2026, across two National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, aiming to enhance coaching standards.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Prepares India for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: The coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati prepared India's promising young shuttlers for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp was recently held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing the nation's U17 and U15 junior badminton players for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India's decision to implement the 3x15 scoring system in junior domestic tournaments will significantly impact how young Indian players compete and develop.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories, effective June 30, 2026.

title: Final Selection Trials Announced for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This notification details the eligibility and qualified players for the final selection trials to represent India at the prestigious VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the player eligibility criteria and the list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Cairo, Egypt.
